ref: IMG_4484 f046 (near square-on; squared up on the black band's edge and the 4-in tile grid)
notes: Black brush-script 'Prime Time Fitness' with four black five-point stars centred below, flat vinyl (or painted) on the glossy white 4-in square-tile sign band whose lower edge is cut in an S-wave over the grille; a black fascia band above.
